title: Senior Growth Manager - CIS

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. title: KOL and Social Manager
description_excerpt:
ABOUT US

ether.fi http://ether.fi/ is one of the largest crypto companies in the world. We have over $10B in assets under management and a team of around 50. We've been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer applications.

The future we envisage is true on-chain banking. Our current products, Stake, Liquid and Cash, let users earn yield across a range of DeFi strategies and spend their assets in the real world with our cards. You can view public analytics on Dune for Cash https://dune.com/ether_fi/etherfi-cash and Stake https://dune.com/ether_fi/etherfi.




POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for a KOL and Social Manager to find, sign and manage KOLs (key opinion leaders: creators and influencers) who bring real users to ether.fi, and to run our day-to-day social posting. This is a user acquisition role: a KOL partnership is worth keeping only if it refers quality users.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Research and scrape to find KOLs whose audiences match our users

 - Build your own tools to speed up sourcing and tracking, using AI-assisted coding (vibe coding)

 - Recruit KOLs, set them up with referral tracking and manage the relationships

 - Track referred users per KOL and cut partnerships that don't perform

 - Spend about an hour a day posting across ether.fi's social channels




YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 - Build a roster of 10-20 KOLs, each referring more than 50 quality users a month




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You can vibe code: you build simple tools and scripts with AI to get work done faster

 - Strong research skills, including scraping to build lists and find people

 - Comfortable posting and running social accounts daily

 - Prior KOL experience is not required

 - Drive, willingness to work hard and go the extra mile. We are a highly ambitious, driven team with audacious goals, and we work very hard to make them a reality

About us
ether.fi is one of the largest crypto companies in the world. We have over $10B in assets under management and a team of around 50. We've been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer applications.
The future we envisage is true on-chain banking. Our current products, Stake, Liquid and Cash, let users earn yield across a range of DeFi strategies and spend their assets in the real world with our cards. You can view public analytics on Dune for Cash and Stake .
